sources.title: Transformer-based model for moroccan Arabizi-to-Arabic transliteration ...
sources.snippet: This work presents the first transformer-based model designed specifically for transliterating Moroccan Arabizi to Arabic. The approach leverages a character-level modeling architecture and a semi-automatically generated dataset containing over 33k word pairs, capturing significant linguistic diversity.
